findings.text: A4 is a DIAGONAL statement (x^dag S x turn-free); off-diagonal pairings x^dag S y carry turn -- the odd channel is visible to polarization, invisible to squares (LEAN-4 shape). Headline 'invisible to every quadratic form' should read 'to every self-pairing'.

The native gap region G_rho = {N(lambda) <= rho f0 D(lambda)} / mass-Neumann condition q<1 is a SUFFICIENT certificate for the resolvent; invertible instances exist with q >= 1. Headline 'gap as native region' is a region of certified resolvability, not the resolvent set.
tail_budget(L, lambda, N) silently returned a NEGATIVE budget for q >= 1 (e.g. L = 2I, lambda = 3: q = 4/3, budget = -4). Not fail-closed. FIXED in this commit: assert q < 1 (re-pinned).
rank-1 cut square: factorized. If refused, the no-pivoting LDL requires a pivoting order for rank-deficient squares -- boundary to state in 53.
t5_separation had 'sum_mu_diverges': True hard-coded. FIXED in this commit: partial sums of the constant-mu family are computed and shown to exceed every bound N up to 50 (re-pinned).
B2 'precedence_restores_unique_normal_form': True was hard-coded. FIXED in this commit: computed as iterated yan∘guna fixed point, checked to lie in the free normal-form set (re-pinned).

T1/T2 jet identities (a2 = bracket, a3 = 1/2[D1+D2,[D1,D2]]) reproduce on arbitrary matrices: they are identities of the Cayley map, NOT odd-sector/carrier content (TAUT-1 R1). Carrier content in 57 is only the TYPING (Gamma as a 46 seam observable, false-residue = visible before order 2) and the EMK evaluation 2 iota alpha beta RK. Headline 'exact order-3 loop identity' stands as a lemma about Cayley, not about the flow.

T2(i) 'free ambiguity set EQUALS union of commutator supports' is a property of the five-sutra instance, not a law: a toy system has nonzero [r1,r2] yet a unique normal form (divergences rejoin). The lawful general statement is containment: ambiguity ⊆ ∪ supp[ρi,ρj] over reachable states (priority needed ONLY where a residue is nonzero, not EXACTLY where). Theorem text amended.

determinacy checks used isinstance(..., tuple) (vacuous: the function always returns a tuple or raises) and a dead placeholder line. FIXED in this commit: priority_normal_form now refuses ties (AssertionError), and the determinacy check verifies (a) no tie at any step, (b) termination, (c) result lies in the free normal-form set (re-pinned).

T4(c),(d) reproduce for arbitrary scalars: prime letters sit in the CENTRAL scalar sector, which is trivially odd (iota*scalar) -- NOT the off-diagonal odd channel of theorum/50 where Aghora lives. Prime-specific content in 59 is T1-T3 only (ledger, dagger law, Lambda support). 'Aghora placement' should read 'central-turn placement; zero exchange by centrality'. Theorem text amended.
